audience: businesses and developers who send SMS with Messente

useCases.title: Check SMS credit and prices
useCases.text: The AI reads the remaining credit in EUR and the account's price per SMS part for a country, per mobile network. Use it to plan a send.

useCases.title: Report messages sent and cost per country
useCases.text: The AI reads total messages and total price per country for a date range, and optionally for chosen message types.

useCases.title: Check if a message was delivered
useCases.text: The AI reads the delivery report of a sent message by its id, with status, error and the price charged.

useCases.title: Check the blacklist for a number
useCases.text: The AI lists the blacklisted numbers or checks whether one number is on the blacklist.

useCases.title: Send an SMS or block a number
useCases.text: The AI sends a text to up to 10 numbers, which spends credit, or adds a number to the blacklist so Messente stops sending to it.
